Explore the preview module in /Users/blaise/Developer/cms/web/src/modules/preview/ and related backend/preview HTML serving.

Goal: Answer whether we can run SEO/AEO/performance/accessibility audits against the previewed HTML page, and what hooks already exist.

Return a concise summary covering:
1. What PreviewPanel currently does (URL loading, iframe, devices, tools)
2. What frameBridge / pageErrors / elementPicker already expose from the iframe document
3. Whether we have same-origin access to preview HTML DOM
4. Any existing audit, SEO, lighthouse, a11y, or meta-tag related code in the repo
5. How preview content is served (local server? file://?)
6. Technical feasibility for: reading meta tags/headings/structured data from DOM; measuring performance; running axe-like a11y checks

Search broadly for: preview, lighthouse, seo, aeo, axe, audit, meta, og:, json-ld

content.text:
**Yes.** Preview already gives you the rendered HTML (daemon crawl of `127.0.0.1:{port}/preview/{id}/`, or same-origin DOM in the iframe). There’s even an approved design for this: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-31-seo-audit-design.md` — on-demand crawl + deterministic rules + **Fix with agent**, as its own **SEO** tab (not inside PreviewPanel). Classic SEO is designed; AEO / perf / a11y are not built yet.

**Already in that SEO design**
- Title / description (presence + length)
- H1 (missing / multiple)
- Image `alt`, `html[lang]`
- Open Graph (`og:title|description|image`)
- `noindex`, broken internal links
- Duplicate titles/descriptions across pages
- `robots.txt` / `sitemap.xml`

**Strong AEO additions** (answer engines / AI overviews)
- JSON-LD present + valid (`Organization`, `WebSite`, `Article`/`BlogPosting`, `FAQPage`, `HowTo`, `BreadcrumbList`)
- FAQ / How-to markup matches visible Q&A copy
- Clear primary entity (who/what the page is about) in title + first paragraph
- Canonical URL + consistent absolute URLs
- Author / date for article-like pages
- Tables / lists for extractable facts (not just prose blobs)
- Speakable / concise answer block near the top (optional heuristic)

**Worth seeing next**
- **Accessibility:** axe-style (contrast, labels, landmarks, focus order) — needs DOM/injection, not pure HTML crawl
- **Content quality:** thin pages, empty main, placeholder copy, missing nav/footer
- **Technical:** soft 404s, redirect chains, mixed content, huge images without dimensions
- **Social:** Twitter/X cards, favicon, apple-touch-icon
- **Performance (heavier):** LCP/CLS/INP via Lighthouse/Playwright — separate infra; not in the SEO design on purpose

**My read of intent:** writers get a checklist before publish, agent can fix — HTML/AEO rules first; skip Lighthouse for v1.

What’s the main job for you — **ship the existing SEO tab**, **extend it with AEO**, or **embed a lighter “Checks” strip inside Preview**?

Find popular Astro SEO, schema, and a11y packages

content.text:
Yes — several exist. None are in this repo today (template only has `mdx` + `orso()`). They split into two kinds:

### Tag helpers (emit meta, don’t audit)
- [`astro-seo`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/astro-seo) — popular `<SEO />` component
- [`@astrolib/seo`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astrolib/seo) — Next-SEO-style tags

### Audit / checks (what you’re asking about)
| Package | Runs when | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| [`astro-seo-audit`](https://github.com/namanlabc/astro-seo-audit) | after `astro build` | SEO score, HTML/JSON/SARIF, regression baseline |
| [`@casoon/astro-post-audit`](https://github.com/casoon/astro-post-audit) | after build (`dist/`) | SEO, links, JSON-LD, static a11y, optional **AI visibility / `llms.txt`** |
| [`@nuasite/checks`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nuasite/checks) | after build | SEO + **GEO/AEO** + perf heuristics + a11y |
| [`astro-seo-enforcer`](https://www.slashgordon.link/post/astro-seo-enforcer/) | after build / CI | Fail build on SEO regressions |
| [`astro-rankcli`](https://rankcli.dev/seo/astro) | after build | Broad audit (280+ rules) |
| [`astro-page-insight`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/astro-page-insight) | **dev overlay** | Lighthouse on the live page |
| [`@astro-a11y/astro-integration`](https://github.com/Stan69000/astro-a11y) | after build | Playwright + axe |

Closest to AEO: **`@nuasite/checks` (GEO)** and **`@casoon/astro-post-audit` (AI visibility / `llms.txt`)**. Closest to “see it in preview”: **`astro-page-insight`**.

**Fit for orso:** almost all audit plugins hit `astro:build:done` / `dist/`, not the running preview. Your approved SEO design crawls the live preview instead — better for writers + “Fix with agent.” Plugins are useful as rule inspiration or optional CI, not as a drop-in for the Preview/SEO tab.

Want me to map the existing SEO design against `@nuasite/checks` / `astro-post-audit` rule lists and pick a v1 AEO gap list?

<timestamp>Saturday, Nov 14, 2026, 3:35 PM (UTC+8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Should orso own it or others should 
</user_query>

**Orso should own the product surface. Don’t make third-party Astro plugins the default path.**

Writers live in preview → findings → **Fix with agent**. Plugins live in `astro build` / CI, fail the build, and speak to developers. That’s a different job. Your approved SEO design already matches orso’s loop; bolting `astro-seo-audit` into the template would not.

| Own in orso | Leave to others |
|---|---|
| When to run (preview ready, on demand) | Heavy engines later if needed (axe, Lighthouse) |
| Plain-language findings + Fix prompts | Optional CI gate in the user’s repo |
| Open in preview / agent outbox | Keeping up with every GEO/AEO fad as npm churn |
| Rules that matter for *publish* | Template tag helpers (`astro-seo`) if authors want them |

**Recommended split**
1. **Orso owns** crawl + deterministic HTML/AEO rules + UI + agent fix (as designed).
2. **Steal ideas, not dependencies** — port rule lists from `@nuasite/checks` / `astro-post-audit`; don’t vendor their integrations into every project.
3. **Optional later** — “Run Lighthouse” / deep a11y as a separate, explicit action (or document “add X in CI”), not the core tab.

Defaulting plugins into the starter would add deps, fail builds on soft warnings, and still miss the agent loop.

One question: is the primary user for this the **writer in the app**, or a **dev gating PRs**? That locks whether CI plugins are complementary or a distraction.
